title: Merge Sorted Playlists
statement: A radio station has several playlists, each a list of song lengths (in seconds) in increasing order. `playlists[i]` is the i-th list. Merge them into one list in increasing order. Some lists may be empty.
constraints: Each list is in increasing order

answerKey.pattern: K-way merge with a min-heap of (value, list, index)
keyPoints: Put the first song of every non-empty list in a min-heap with its list number and position
Pop the smallest, add it to the result, and push the next song from the same list
The heap never holds more than k items
answerKey.timeComplexity: O(N log k) for N songs in k lists
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Concatenate and sort: O(N log N)
Merge the lists two at a time: O(N k)

hints: The smallest remaining song is always the first unused song of one of the lists. How do you find the smallest of k candidates quickly?
Keep one candidate per list in a min-heap.
Store (length, list, position); after popping, push the next song from the same list if there is one.
